name: DSAIReadable
framework: React 19 / Next.js 16 / Tailwind CSS v4 / shadcn/ui

brands.activation: A brand is a class on <html>, next to `dark`: nova is the `nova` class, lyra the absence of a class. It covers colors, typefaces, corners and text sizes, and semantic classes follow it: never write a value or a class for one brand.

shadcn_excluded.reason: shadcn/ui's former form layer, built on react-hook-form. shadcn/ui now builds its forms on Field, which the design system ships: Field lays out the label, the control, the description and the error, and leaves the form state to whichever library the app uses.
